input.summary: orders_between used an exclusive upper bound (`< end`), so orders on the end date were dropped. I changed it to `<= end` and added a regression test.
input.root_cause: The filter in app/reports.py orders_between used `start <= o.placed_on < end`, which excludes the end date.

claims.statement: The bug was the exclusive upper bound in orders_between
The regression test failed before the fix, returning [2] instead of [2, 3]
All tests pass after the fix

input.uncertainty: Callers that relied on the old exclusive end behaviour were not checked. A search found no other uses of orders_between in the repository.
